question: What is the range of mortality rates across all five states from 2019 to 2022? (A) about 5 to 12 per 100k (B) about 12 to 25 per 100k (C) about 8.6 to 18.1 per 100k. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the public_health line chart. All series are drawn in near-identical blues, so series are hard to tell apart. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): ineffective color scheme. True answer: C (about 8.6 to 18.1 per 100k). Bait: A (about 5 to 12 per 100k).
